answer: Like a mycelium lattice threading between root systems, decentralized trust crystallizes through symbiotic proof-of-stake bonds. A brittle fake node finds no foothold among the hardy roots of a juniper or the supple canopy of a willow, where cryptographic nectar—validator reward—only flows to attested histories. Creating forged identities requires exponential stake bonding, imposing superlinear capital costs that starve Sybil swarms before consensus.
